title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Nice Blue Razz Ice 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Seriously Nice Blue Razz Ice from Doozy Vape Co. is a deliciously decadent blue raspberry flavour, bursting with that iconic flavour’s rich, juicy Blueberry and Raspberry character. Syrupy sweet and endlessly satisfying – the cool rush of menthol on the exhale finishes of this exquisite e-liquid to perfection. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle really helps your favourite e-liquid go the distance and comes with 25ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. This e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mod vapes and sub-ohm tanks .
